title: AITC Canonical Contracts v1.0.0
description: Language-neutral canonical contracts (03_CANONICAL_CONTRACTS.md). This schema is the authoritative source from which the Go, TypeScript and Python representations are generated or validated. No component may redefine these structures independently (25_DEEP_ARCHITECTURAL_AUDIT_AND_FULL_SCALE_RELEASE_PROFILE.md section 4).

entityType.description: Closed set of canonical identifier prefixes. An unknown value is unsupported and must never be silently mapped. This set is kept identical to contracts.EntityTypes() by TestSchemaFileDeclaresSameVocabulariesAsGo; a prefix listed here with no Go counterpart mints identifiers that ParseID rejects.

canonicalId.description: Typed prefix + '_' + 20 lowercase Crockford Base32 characters (100 bits of entropy). Crockford Base32 excludes i, l, o and u on encoding.

decimal.description: Strict base-10 decimal literal. Exponents, whitespace, thousands separators, hex and non-finite values are rejected. Trailing fractional zeros are significant scale metadata and are preserved.

money.description: Canonical monetary value. The amount is a JSON string so that no JSON decoder can introduce a float into an authoritative financial value.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code, or an explicitly configured digital-asset code. A well-formed code is NOT evidence of eligibility for any account, venue or jurisdiction.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 with nanosecond precision. A non-UTC offset is accepted on parse and normalised to UTC; the canonical stored and transmitted form is always UTC with a literal Z.

traceId.description: Bounded printable identifier recorded in audit records. Length and character restrictions prevent log injection and unbounded audit growth.

environment.description: Deployment scope. Each environment has separate credentials, database, keys, deployment identity, network policy and configuration namespace.

environmentOrder.description: Promotion ladder. Promotion is monotonic; backward movement requires an explicit audited rollback record.

actorType.description: Human, workload, system, agent or break-glass. A workload can never impersonate a human.

authStrength.description: Phishing-resistant assurance (FIDO2/WebAuthn) is required for privileged roles and every step-up-gated action.

marketClass.description: Independently enabled market scope. Enabling one never implies another.

tradingStatus.description: UNKNOWN is not tradable: an unverifiable status fails closed.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. An unsupported version is rejected, never silently mapped.

errorBody.description: Canonical error body. Internal causes are never serialised; hostnames, addresses, SQL and vendor error text must not appear here.

retryable.description: Advisory only. It never authorises a blind retry of a financial command; TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN is never retryable.

commandStatus.description: 'accepted' means durably accepted, NOT that a venue accepted, filled or acknowledged anything. 'outcome_unknown' means the client must query canonical state and must not retry with a new idempotency key.

commandEnvelope.description: Canonical wrapper for every externally initiated mutating request. Unknown request fields are rejected on commands (15_API_AND_INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS.md section 1).

causation_id.description: Absent only for a top-level externally initiated command.

idempotency_key.description: Scoped to actor + endpoint + environment. Reuse with a different request body is a CONFLICT, not a silent replay.

eventEnvelope.description: Canonical wrapper for every durable domain event. Unknown fields are tolerated on events (additive-compatible).

source_timestamp.description: Present when the event originates from an external venue or provider. Mandatory for market data.

sequence.description: Monotonic within the aggregate. A missing or non-positive sequence is routed to controlled reconciliation rather than accepted.

idempotencyRecord.description: Durable replay-suppression record enforced by a unique constraint. Application memory is never sufficient.

state.description: 'unknown' records an unprovable downstream outcome. A replay returns outcome_unknown and must NOT re-execute.
